text:
```yaml
name: Termux Tests

on:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly on Sunday at midnight UTC

jobs:
  termux-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Run Termux tests (base requirements)
        uses: n1hility/cross-arch-action@v1
        with:
          arch: aarch64
          distro: termux
          run: |
            pkg update -y
            pkg install -y python
            python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer

  termux-full:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Run Termux tests (full requirements)
        uses: n1hility/cross-arch-action@v1
        with:
          arch: aarch64
          distro: termux
          run: |
            pkg update -y
            pkg install -y python
            pip install -r requirements-full.txt
            python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer
```
